## Checks

- [ ] `node tools/check.mjs full` passes locally (CI runs it on Windows, macOS and Linux).
- [ ] New code has tests, and each new test can fail (its negative control is named).
- [ ] A bug fix has a regression test that fails with the bug put back.
- [ ] Golden files changed only with an explained, intended change.
- [ ] No new package, or the `vet-package` report is linked and the owner said yes.
- [ ] Docs follow the change: `docs/current-work.md`, `docs/follow-ups.md`, a decision record if needed.
- [ ] A change to file access, config loading, hooks, CI or dependencies had a `security-reviewer` review.
